meta.purpose: Maps every academic subject and professional domain to the papers, chapters and skills that teach it, so that one concept can be traced across the whole system.

subjects.name: Accounting Fundamentals
subjects.description: Double entry, accrual concepts, final accounts and the accounting equation. The base layer for every other reporting subject.

subjects.name: Accounting Standards (AS)
subjects.description: The 12 specified standards for Paper 6 plus the standards examined in Paper 10. Recognition, measurement and disclosure for each.

subjects.name: Ind AS — Fundamentals and Advanced Applications
subjects.description: Converged standards: framework, presentation, revenue, leases, financial instruments, impairment, business combinations and consolidation.

subjects.name: Corporate Accounting
subjects.description: Share capital, debentures, Schedule III presentation, cash flow statements and sector accounts.

subjects.name: Financial Reporting
subjects.description: Preparation, presentation and interpretation of general purpose financial statements, including consolidation and recent developments.

subjects.name: Companies Act, 2013
subjects.description: Incorporation, constitutional documents, capital, directors, meetings, charges, dividends, restructuring, winding up and audit provisions. 40% of Paper 5.

subjects.name: Corporate and Economic Laws
subjects.description: IBC, SEBI, competition, FEMA, banking and insurance regulation, MSME, cyber law and AML.

subjects.name: Commercial Law — Contracts and Transactions
subjects.description: Contract Act, Sale of Goods, Negotiable Instruments, Partnership and LLP.

subjects.name: Industrial and Labour Law
subjects.description: Factories Act, gratuity, PF, ESI and the Code on Wages. 15% of Paper 5 and heavily memory-based.

subjects.name: Business Ethics and Governance
subjects.description: Ethical theory, emotional intelligence, the professional code, conflicts of interest, whistle-blowing and governance mechanisms. 15% of Paper 5.

subjects.name: Cost Accounting
subjects.description: Cost ascertainment, methods and techniques — the core discipline of the CMA qualification.

subjects.name: Costing Techniques and Control
subjects.description: Standard costing, variance analysis, budgeting, marginal costing, learning curves and cost reduction.

subjects.name: Management Accounting
subjects.description: Decision support: relevant costing, CVP, transfer pricing, divisional performance, responsibility accounting and decision theory.

subjects.name: Strategic Cost Management
subjects.description: Value chain, ABC/ABM, target and life-cycle costing, throughput accounting, pricing and strategic performance measurement.

subjects.name: Financial Management
subjects.description: Ratio analysis, cost of capital, capital budgeting, working capital and financing decisions. 80% of Paper 11.

subjects.name: Strategic Financial Management
subjects.description: Investment decisions, security analysis, portfolio management, derivatives, risk management and international finance.

subjects.name: Direct Taxation
subjects.description: Income tax computation across the five heads, deductions, and corporate/individual assessment. 50% of Paper 7 and 60% of Paper 15.

subjects.name: International Taxation
subjects.description: DTAA, permanent establishment, transfer pricing, BEPS and GAAR. 40% of Paper 15.

subjects.name: Indirect Taxation
subjects.description: GST and Customs — the supply concept, credit mechanics, valuation, procedure and litigation.

subjects.name: Goods and Services Tax
subjects.description: Registration, supply, place and time of supply, valuation, input tax credit, returns, refunds and appeals. 35% of Paper 7 and 70% of Paper 19.

subjects.name: Customs Law and Practice
subjects.description: Levy, valuation, procedures, warehousing, drawback and litigation. 10% of Paper 7 and 30% of Paper 19.

subjects.name: Auditing and Assurance
subjects.description: Audit concepts, evidence, risk, the Companies Act audit provisions, audit reports and internal audit. 50% of Paper 10.

subjects.name: Cost and Management Audit
subjects.description: Cost audit, management audit, internal and operational audit, forensic audit and AML. The CMA's signature practice area.

subjects.name: Strategic Management
subjects.description: Strategic analysis, formulation, implementation and digital strategy. 40% of Paper 9.

subjects.name: Operations Management
subjects.description: Operations planning, OR applications, quality, project management and maintenance. 60% of Paper 9.

subjects.name: Business Data Analytics
subjects.description: The data lifecycle, cleaning, visualisation and modelling for business decisions. 20% of Paper 11 and the bridge to the analytics academy.
